sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed "Date info - Decade"/"- Month" checkboxes highlighting the matching atom's WHOLE date text (e.g. all of "2008-07-15") instead of just the specific component that made it match — checking a decade now highlights only that atom's own "YYYY" (e.g. "2008"), and checking a month now highlights only its own "MM" digit pair (e.g. "07"), via lookbehind/lookahead-anchored regexes in `_highlightDateAtomMatch()` that never touch the surrounding date text (nor, for a range, the OTHER side's atom).
